messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered for service routing-proxy-eu-west-2 — incident PD12345. Symptoms: spike in 5xx (502/503), latency increase, ~15% request drop for traffic routed to az-e2. Autotriage suggests pod evictions and NIC errors in az-e2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345: triggered at 2026-03-15T04:12:25Z. Urgency: high. Assigned to sasha_oncall.

sasha_oncall: acked. stepping in. can someone post recent grafana snapshots and a quick customer-impact estimate?

anya_prod: seeing elevated errors in EU tenants — several key customers reported timeouts. Not widespread but affects ~12% of EU traffic to inference endpoints. Screenshots incoming.

mike_sre: oncall standby — I'm pulling host-level metrics. looks like NIC drops around 04:08 — align with pod restarts on node pool az-e2-nodeset-3.

kevin_infra: confirming node churn: autoscaler evicted 3 nodes 04:07 due to underlying fabric errors. kubelet restarted containers -> KV cache cold starts.

chandra_network: I can see network errors from the hypervisor side — E2 NIC reported link flaps to the top-of-rack switch. ticket to cloud provider opened: CLOUD-7892.

sasha_oncall: TL;DR: az-e2 experiencing NIC flaps -> node churn -> routing-proxy backend errors. Impact: routing failures for pods in az-e2, partial regional degradation. Plan: 1) enable routing divert for traffic away from az-e2 to az-e1/az-e3 (soft failover), 2) enable degraded-mode cache warming, 3) scale up routing pool in other AZs to absorb extra load, 4) monitor customer impact and notify.

mike_sre: recommend activating fallback policy API: 
```
POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/fallback
{
  "region": "eu-west-2",
  "exclude_az": ["az-e2"],
  "reason": "NIC flaps az-e2",
  "initiator": "sasha_oncall"
}
```

sasha_oncall: running fallback now. will post command output.

sasha_oncall: output: 200 OK — fallback policy active. traffic diverted away from az-e2 to az-e1/az-e3. live-check: samples show error rate down from 14% -> 1.8% overall. latency up ~60ms p50 due to cross-az hops.

anya_prod: sending customer comms draft to #customer-notify: "We experienced a regional degradation affecting some EU customers between 04:05-04:25 UTC. Traffic was automatically diverted; most requests succeeded with slightly higher latency. We will follow up with an RCA." please review.

mike_sre: validated KV cache warming: triggered background rebuilds on az-e1/az-e3; CPU spike observed but within headroom. Autoscaler increased routing-proxy instances by +30% in az-e1/az-e3.

kevin_infra: cloud provider confirmed intermittent NIC errors on az-e2 patching pool — they are doing node reimaging. provider ETA ~ 40m.

chandra_network: still seeing retries from control plane to some backend IPs in az-e2; keep exclude_az in place until provider confirms stable.

sasha_oncall: handoff: I'm going to go offline for 20m to coordinate with provider and update the PD. handing primary to mike_sre. mike — you have PD and this thread.

mike_sre: ack handoff. will monitor and escalate if fallback fails or latency/customer errors increase. tagging @eng-sre for awareness.

anya_prod: customers notified. no P1 SLAs breached yet; some elevated error rates but mitigated via fallback. cc: support to triage any outstanding tickets.

incident-bot: Note: autopager timers — if pager remains unacked by primary for >5m, escalation to ops-lead occurs. (already acked).

mike_sre: next steps checklist: 1) keep az-e2 excluded until CLOUD-7892 resolved; 2) confirm nodes restored and kube stability for 2x pod restart cycles; 3) run warmup job for KV caches in az-e2 before re-adding; 4) prepare rollback plan to re-enable az-e2 routing and monitor 1h. assigning ownership: kevin_infra (node health), chandra_network (network validation), sasha_oncall (provider comms), mike_sre (monitor + re-enable).

kevin_infra: will post node health summary in 15m.

chandra_network: will run connectivity probe script `tools/netprobe --region eu-west-2 --az az-e2` and paste results here once done.

mike_sre: closing notes for PD: PD12345 -> status: mitigated (routing divert active). Last update: 2026-03-15T04:20:02Z. moving to monitor state. assigning postmortem owners: sasha_oncall, kevin_infra.

anya_prod: thanks all. once provider confirms, we'll coordinate gradual re-enable with canary traffic. :thumbsup:
